ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, general partners, and authorized signatories against (i) the EU Council Consolidated Financial Sanctions List as implemented by the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance; (ii) UN Security Council sanctions lists; (iii) the OFAC SDN list for all USD-denominated bond and customs transactions; (iv) INTERPOL and domestic enforcement databases; plus FATF-compliant PEP determination with risk-tiered enhanced due diligence applicable when PEP status is identified. For the declared Low_Risk_Standard customs bonded trucking activity, standard customer due diligence applies, with annual refresh and continuous sanctions event monitoring under CSSF Regulation 12-02.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - lbr.lu; RCS (Registre de Commerce et des Societes) filing interface operated by the Ministry of Justice; pre-incorporation name verification performed via the notary's RCS intranet channel
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be composed in Latin script and may be expressed in one of the administrative languages (French, German, Luxembourgish) or in any other language using Latin characters. The legal form indicator 'Societe en Commandite Speciale' or its abbreviation 'SCSp' is mandatory. Names must not be contrary to public order or good morals, must not be misleading, and must be distinguishable from all existing names registered in the RCS, including transliterations.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Luxembourg (unless properly licensed or clearly non-official context)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection by the RCS or notarial pre-clearance, the applicant, acting through a Luxembourg notary, may (1) resubmit a modified name with a distinct differentiating element within 5 business days; (2) file a formal written appeal with the RCS Registrar within 15 days of the rejection, pursuant to the Law of 19 December 2002 on the register of commerce and companies and the accounting and annual accounts of undertakings, as amended; (3) if the Registrar maintains the refusal, bring an action before the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement, commercial chamber) within one month of the appeal decision. No extension of the original 30-day reservation window is otherwise available; the applicant must recommence name reservation after exhaustion of appeals.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially_Permitted_With_Domiciliation_Agent - The SCSp must maintain a registered office in Luxembourg under the Law of 10 August 1915 (Part IV bis) and the Law of 31 May 1999 on domiciliation of companies. A virtual office is acceptable only through an approved domiciliation agent under a written domiciliation agreement. However, for ISIC 5222 customs bonded trucking operations, commercial substance must be independently demonstrated through the general partner's management presence, lease or operating contracts for the bonded truck fleet, customs authorizations (e.g., AEO-CT or customs warehouse approvals), and physical maintenance of fleet records; a pure letterbox office will be insufficient for the issuance of customs transport licenses.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate_Likelihood_40_Percent - Unannounced inspections by the Luxembourg Customs and Excise Agency (Administration des douanes et accises, ADA) and the RBE are reasonably foreseeable given the customs bonded license requirement, endorsing a risk of physical inspection moderately above the standard corporate baseline.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Loi modifiée du 10 août 1915 concernant les sociétés commerciales, Articles 12-1 through 12-8 (société en commandite simple / spéciale), as amended by the Loi du 12 juillet 2013 relating to alternative investment fund managers and subsequent company law reforms; Règlement grand-ducal on the Register of Commerce and Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), Luxembourg.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration en vue de l'inscription au Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés accompanied by the acte constitutif / contrat de société (partnership agreement) or a notarial extract thereof.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for an SCSp; contributions are freely fixed in the partnership agreement and no escrow account is required at incorporation. For customs-bonded trucking, the Customs and Excise Agency requires a comprehensive guarantee or cash deposit (typically EUR 20,000–50,000) as security for customs debt before bonded operations commence.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: WRITTEN RESOLUTIONS OF THE GENERAL PARTNER OF [NAME] SCSp – FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION. RESOLVED: (1) the partnership agreement is adopted and the subscription of all partnership interests is approved; (2) the registered office of the SCSp is fixed at [address], Luxembourg; (3) [Name] is appointed sole managing partner (gérant) with exclusive representation authority; (4) the gérant is directed to complete RCS registration, RESA publication, VAT and employer registrations; (5) the SCSp shall not commence customs-bonded trucking until all industrial, customs and environmental authorisations are obtained; (6) a corporate bank account may be opened and the specimen signature of the gérant is approved.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Execute the SCSp Partnership Agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (notaire) in private practice; alternatively the partners acting by private writing under Article 12-1(2) of the Law of 10 August 1915.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the limited partnership agreement (contrat de société) naming the general partner (associé commandité) and the limited partners (associés commanditaires), defining capital contributions, profit-sharing ratios, transfer restrictions, management powers and dissolution terms. Execute the deed before a Luxembourg notary for maximum legal certainty and bank acceptability, or have each partner sign and date the original private deed. The notary will register the deed and deliver authenticated copies.
required_dossiers: Draft partnership agreement
Passport or national ID and proof of residence of each partner
Certificate of incorporation and register of directors for any corporate partner
LEI code and statutory corporate documents for a corporate general partner
Beneficial ownership information of the partnership
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects a deficiency in partner capacity, contribution schedule or governance clause, an acte rectificatif (corrective deed) is executed and re-attached before any registry filing; private deeds are redrafted and re-signed by all partners.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the SCSp with the RCS
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), online filing portal at lbr.lu.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the RCS registration application through the LBR electronic system: upload the partnership deed or notarial extract, the signed consent of the registered office, the identification of the gérant, and the beneficial owner declaration. Pay the official filing fee online. The RCS registrar verifies the dossier and issues the registration certificate and RCS number (B/NNNNNN).
required_dossiers: Notarised partnership deed or original private deed
RCS electronic registration form
Consent of the owner of the registered office / domiciliation agreement
Identification of the managing partner (gérant)
Beneficial ownership declaration
Proof of payment of the filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The RCS issues a 'régularisation' enquiry requesting corrected or supplementary documents; the applicant cures within the one-month deadline. A formal refusal may be appealed to the Luxembourg District Court as a commercial matter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the RESA Official Electronic Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Recueil électronique des sociétés et associations (RESA) – official electronic gazette administered by the Luxembourg Business Registers (resa.lu).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the RCS registration is completed, the notary or law firm uploads the statutory extract to the RESA platform and settles the publication fee. The publication becomes the effective publicity against third parties for the SCSp's constitution and for the limitation of liability of the limited partners.
required_dossiers: RCS registration certificate
Notarial copy or extracts of the partnership agreement
RESA submission form and fee invoice
Power of attorney for the filing representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RESA publication file is rejected on technical grounds, the notary corrects formatting or pagination and re-submits; publication errors are corrected through a subsequent rectification notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: VAT and Tax Registration with the AEDT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) – Luxembourg indirect tax administration, via the Guichet.lu business portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the VAT registration (Form 1001) together with the RCS extract and the partnership deed on the AEDT portal. The AEDT allocates the Luxembourg VAT number in the format LU ########. As the SCSp is tax-transparent, each partner is separately assessed on its share of income, but the partnership files annual informational declarations and periodic VAT returns for its operations.
required_dossiers: RCS extract dated less than 3 months
Partnership agreement or notarial deed
Bank account details and IBAN
Form 1001 and tax mandate
Identification of the VAT representative if any partner is non-EU resident
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The AEDT may request clarifications or supplementary documents; the application is simply reactivated after the response. Unjustified rejection can be challenged through a written objection to the Director of the AEDT within 3 months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Customs-Bonded and Road Transport Operating Licences
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration des douanes et accises (Customs and Excise Agency) and Ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics – Direction de la réglementation des transports terrestres, Luxembourg.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the road haulage establishment licence under Regulation (EC) No 1071/2009 by proving financial standing, professional competence and good repute; simultaneously apply for the customs authorisation for Union transit and bonded operations under Regulation (EU) No 952/2013 (Union Customs Code) by lodging a comprehensive guarantee with the Customs and Excise Agency through the NCTS system. For airport-feeder operations, execute the vehicle access and security agreement with the airport operator. Upon approval, obtain the Community Licence and the customs guarantee reference number (GRN) before the first bonded movement.
required_dossiers: RCS extract and partnership constitution deed
Proof of financial standing (audited accounts or bank guarantee)
Transport manager certificate of professional competence (CAP)
Comprehensive customs guarantee or cash deposit covering customs debt
Motor third-party liability and road transport insurance certificates
Airport access and security clearance agreement with the Luxembourg airport operator
Vehicle fleet registration list and GPS-sealing technical specifications
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Administrative refusals may be appealed to the administrative courts within 3 months. If the customs guarantee is assessed as insufficient, the operator may increase the guarantee amount or provide a cash deposit to lift the suspension.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Administration des douanes et accises (Customs and Excise Agency) for customs-bonded authorisations; Ministère de la Mobilité et des Travaux publics – Direction de la réglementation des transports terrestres for road haulage licensing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licence d'établissement de transporteur routier de marchandises (Community Licence) and authorisation as a bonded carrier with Union Customs Code comprehensive guarantee / NCTS approved operator status.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Administration de l'environnement – Ministère de l'Environnement, du Climat et de la Biodiversité, Luxembourg.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Établissement classé – Klasse 3 (Déclaration) under the Law of 10 June 1999 on classified establishments for a truck depot and maintenance workshop; a full EIA report is triggered only if fuel storage capacity exceeds 50,000 litres or significant emissions thresholds are met (Klasse 1 – Autorisation commodo/incommodo).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater from truck washing: compliance with the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 14 November 2012 on discharges into public sewers (suspended solids ≤ 35 mg/L; oils and greases ≤ 5 mg/L); VOC control for fuel storage under Directive 94/63/EC (Stage I petrol vapour recovery for tanks above 50 m³); waste management under Directive 2008/98/EC for used tyres, lubricants, oil filters and batteries; engine idling restrictions to comply with the national ambient air quality standards under Directive 2008/50/EC.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate (certificat de sécurité incendie) issued by the Inspection générale de la Protection civile (CGDIS); structural stability attestation for the truck depot, canopies and loading docks issued by a qualified structural engineer; occupational health and safety clearance from the Inspection du travail et des mines (ITM); communal site-operation approval under the building permit for the depot and vehicle parking area.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Administration des contributions directes (ACD) for direct income taxes; Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT) for VAT registration, filing, and recovery; unified digital access via MyGuichet.lu and the guichet.lu official portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign SCSp with Luxembourg economic nexus must: (1) file incorporation and register with the Luxembourg Business Registers (Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés) via MyGuichet to obtain the 10-digit national business registration number (matricule national); (2) appoint a Luxembourg-established VAT agent or approved tax representative if the partnership has no fixed local establishment; (3) submit the AEDT VAT registration application (form 640/A or equivalent electronic immatriculation dossier) declaring intended commencement date, turnover projections, and activity codes (ISIC 5222 road feeder / customs bonded transport); (4) receive the Luxembourg VAT identification number in the format LU + 8 digits; and (5) obtain separate national natural-person identification numbers for the partners, managers, and any Luxembourg permanent establishment staff registered with ACD.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible — Luxembourg SCSp is fiscally transparent by default and is not itself subject to Luxembourg corporate income tax (CIT), municipal business tax (Uber Gewerbesteuer), or net wealth tax; the partners are taxed on their allocated share of income in accordance with their residence and the territorial nexus rules, and non-resident partners without a Luxembourg permanent establishment are generally outside Luxembourg income tax on capital gains.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Article 2 LIR option: an SCSp may irrevocably elect to be treated as a non-transparent Luxembourg tax-resident corporation for Luxembourg tax purposes if all general partners are Luxembourg-resident corporate entities subject to full CIT; transparency mismatches with the country of a foreign partner are addressed through the hybrid mismatch rules implemented under the law of 20 December 2019 (ATAD I), which deny deductions in cases of double deduction or deduction-without-inclusion outcomes; there is no US-style check-the-box election in Luxembourg, but a tax ruling from the ACD Direct Tax Directorate is available to confirm the default transparent classification and to prevent multiple or inconsistent entity classification in cross-border structures.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax; Luxembourg: Taxe sur la valeur ajoutée - TVA), aligned with Council Directive 2006/112/EC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover for the small business exemption; registration is mandatory regardless of the threshold when making taxable supplies subject to the reverse-charge mechanism, engaging in intra-Community acquisitions, importing goods, or providing transport and freight services connected with customs-bonded cross-border flows.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg does not operate a continuous transaction control or real-time fiscal clearance system for B2B invoices; e-invoicing is mandatory for B2G public contracts through the PEPPOL BIS 3.0 network; VAT returns and listing declarations must be filed electronically via the eCDF / MyGuichet platform; no digital stamping regime applies; interoperability and integrity requirements for the GPS-sealed fleet data exports follow the general invoicing integrity requirements of the Luxembourg VAT legislation, with SAF-T (Standard Audit File for Tax) formats announced for future electronic audit use.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated export treatment applies under Articles 166 to 170 of the Luxembourg VAT law where: (i) the SCSp acts as the supplier/exporter holding a valid Luxembourg VAT number; (ii) goods physically leave EU territory, including cargo transported by the customs-bonded truck fleet to a non-EU destination, within the legal dispatch/shipment window; and (iii) services rendered directly in relation to the transport of goods to/from third countries, or ancillary services to such transport, are supplied to a customer established outside the EU and are directly connected to the export movement; documentary proof must be retained for at least ten years.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (SAD / IE-529) lodged through EU CDS or LUCY bearing a valid Movement Reference Number (MRN)
Bill of Lading or CMR road consignment note evidencing the customs-bonded truck carriage and physical exit of goods from EU territory
Inward Remittance Certificate evidencing receipt of foreign-currency export consideration on the SCSp's bank account
Commercial invoice, packing list, and export contract referencing the GPS-sealed bonded road feeder operation
Proof of physical exit (e.g., exit certificate, customs transit (T-carrier) closure notice, or police ravitaillement stamp) issued by the customs office of departure
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEDT may retrospectively claw back zero-rated output VAT with statutory late-payment interest of 0.8% per month where export evidence is absent, incomplete, or deemed fictitious; intentional or fraudulent zero-rating claims trigger administrative fines ranging from 10% to 100% of the VAT at risk, criminal sanctions (up to EUR 25,000 fine and imprisonment under the General Tax Law) for the partners or officers, and a retroactive reassessment period extended from the standard five years to ten years in cases of fraud; the 180-day FX repatriation timeframe is a monetary-compliance condition, and a failure to repatriate does not by itself invalidate a genuine export, but a permanent absence of foreign exchange receipt will materially weaken the evidentiary basis for zero-rating during audit review and may expose the claim to full clawback with penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL), operating in coordination with the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) as banking supervisor; customs supervision for bonded fleet operations is exercised by the Administration des douanes et accises under the Union Customs Code.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full capital and current account convertibility; the euro is unconditionally convertible with zero exchange-control restrictions under Articles 63-66 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union and the EU Capital Movements Directive 88/361/EEC. Profit remittances from a Société en Commandite Spéciale (SCSp) are not subject to Luxembourg withholding tax (tax-transparent partnership) and face no administrative remittance barrier. Practical hurdles are limited to BCL statistical reporting thresholds, AML/UBO verification, AIFMD classification review, and Luxembourg substance requirements for the feeder-trucking operation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Luxembourg is a full Eurozone member and imposes no statutory timeline, mandatory conversion ratio, or surrender obligation on export receipts. FX-denominated income (e.g., USD air-freight receivables) may be held indefinitely in multi-currency current accounts. Statutory obligations are limited to: (i) export declarations via the Single Administrative Document (SAD) and NCTS transit system filed with the Administration des douanes et accises; (ii) physical cash declaration under Regulation (EU) 2018/1672 for movements of EUR 10,000 or more; and (iii) BCL balance-of-payments reporting executed by the resident credit institution on a flow threshold basis.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Banque et Caisse d'Épargne de l'État (BCEE) - Spuerkeess

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: FEASIBILITY: LOW-MEDIUM. EEA-licensed electronic money institutions (EMIs) passporting into Luxembourg under the E-Money Directive 2009/110/EC and PSD2 may be used exclusively for ancillary outbound disbursements (small-scale fuel payments, tolls, and courier fees). They cannot serve as the primary treasury vehicle because EMIs are not credit institutions: they cannot extend credit or provide customs guarantee facilities, they offer only incidental FX conversion, and they are structurally unsuitable for capital escrow or bonded-transit guarantee arrangements. A fully licensed credit institution remains mandatory for capital escrow, customs guarantees, and cross-border settlement rails.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: MANDATE: Physical attendance strongly required. Under the amended Luxembourg AML Law of 12 November 2004 and CSSF Regulation 12-02, customer due diligence must be performed face-to-face unless the client presents an eIDAS-compliant qualified electronic identification accepted by the bank. For a SCSp, which lacks separate legal personality, at least one authorised natural person representing the General Partner must attend an in-person onboarding meeting at the bank's Luxembourg premises with valid national ID/passport, proof of address, and the notarised delegation of authority (pouvoirs). Remote/podium KYC is occasionally permitted for this Low_Risk_Standard client segment, but only at the bank's discretionary risk-committee approval.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SCSp has no separate legal personality; bank cannot determine which organ holds signatory authority over account funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified excerpt of the partnership agreement (LPA) expressly granting the General Partner exclusive management and bank-account authority; extract from the Luxembourg Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) proving registration; current notarised delegation of authority board resolution of the GP; specimen signatures of the authorised signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque multi-tier limited-partner ownership structure and inability to identify ultimate beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) filing certificate under the Law of 13 January 2019; UBO declaration with 25% ownership thresholds identified; full corporate-organisational chart; LP subscription agreements; source-of-wealth materials for investor capital contributions; reliance on the subscribed capital call schedule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Customs-adjacent bonded trucking activity viewed as elevated-risk for invoice fraud, excise evasion, or goods diversion.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid AEO (Authorised Economic Operator) certificate or pending application; NCTS/ARN transit movement records; customs comprehensive guarantee reference issued to the Administration des douanes et accises; contracts with bonded warehouses and airport cargo operators at Luxembourg-Findel; fleet GPS-seal and tracking audit trail; license documents evidencing the statutory operating permit for ISIC 5222.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulatory classification ambiguity: SCSp may be deemed an Alternative Investment Fund requiring CSSF or RAIF regime compliance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Memorandum of legal analysis confirming the SCSp operates an active commercial trucking business rather than a collective investment undertaking; private-placement confirmation letters from investors; confirmation of exemption under Article 2 or Article 3 of the AIFM Law of 12 July 2013, or the CSSF-AIF authorisation number if the structure is regulated.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (i) EEA investor contributions below EUR 100,000 via SEPA Credit Transfer (ISO 20022 pain.001) using purpose code EQUI (equity contribution) or INTC (intercompany); (ii) large or non-EEA injections via SWIFT MT103 through a TARGET2-participating Luxembourg bank, with purpose code EQUI in the remittance field and the SCSp RCS registration number plus designated IBAN as beneficiary; (iii) all injections matched against issued capital drawdown notices and investor-side AML/UBO verification packs; (iv) BCL balance-of-payments reporting automatically performed by the receiving credit institution under ECB Regulation 1745/2017 thresholds; (v) funds held exclusively in a structurally subordinated capital escrow account until the General Partner issues a drawdown certificate for fleet acquisition, customs guarantees, or working capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails: SWIFT MT103/MT202 definitive payments to fuel suppliers, customs brokers, bonded warehouse operators, and airport ground-handling agents; commercial Letters of Credit under UCP 600 issued by tier-1 Luxembourg banks for capital equipment purchases (tractors and customs-sealed trailers), utilising advising and confirming bank chains; customs Comprehensive Guarantees provided by BCEE, BGL BNP Paribas, or Société Générale Luxembourg as irrevocable bank guarantees to the Administration des douanes et accises; urgent transactions below EUR 100,000 executed via SEPA Instant Credit Transfer (SCT Inst); large fleet purchases settled through the bank's trade finance desk with full ICC documentary compliance.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards - deliverable EUR/USD, EUR/CHF and EUR/GBP contracts executed under ISDA 2002 or the bank's FX Master Agreement for settlement of hard-currency import obligations
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) - permitted for restricted or exotic currency pairs where EUR delivery is impossible, collateralised under an ISDA Credit Support Annex with bank counterparty lines
Cross-Currency Swaps and FX Swaps - periodic working-capital conversion between EUR and USD or EUR and JPY to hedge monthly revenue repatriation and fleet-finance cash flows
OTC Plain-Vanilla Currency Options - zero-cost collars and purchased European-style put/call options to protect the bonded trucking margin without speculative exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of RCS registered data (confirmation annuelle des informations au RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: must be completed during the calendar month following the anniversary of the entity's initial RCS registration; repeated each year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine of up to EUR 500 per violation; persistent non-filing triggers formal reminder from LBR, automatic enforcement by the registry, and possible administrative strike-off of the SCSp from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of beneficial owner information (confirmation annuelle du registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers – Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: within one month after the anniversary of the entity's RBE registration; any transfer of limited partnership interests or change to beneficial ownership separately requires an RBE update within one month of that event.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal penalties: EUR 2,000 to EUR 20,000 fine and/or imprisonment of 6 months to 5 years for intentional default; administrative fines up to EUR 125 per day for late or false RBE declarations.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Independent statutory audit required if the undertaking exceeds at least two of the following three thresholds per Luxembourg Law of 19 December 2002: balance sheet total EUR 17.5 million; net turnover EUR 35 million; average workforce 250 employees. Undertakings below these thresholds (small/micro) are exempt unless audit is required under AIFMD, regulatory licence, or the partnership agreement. An SCSp engaged in customs bonded trucking remains subject to the transport operator licensing audit expectations only when the licence authority demands audited financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP under the Law of 19 December 2002 on accounting records and annual accounts is the default; EU-endorsed IFRS is permitted for statutory/consolidated accounts. The SCSp must keep books and records in accordance with Luxembourg accounting law so that its tax transparency position can be reported.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SCSp must confirm the identity of beneficial owners through the RBE online portal each year during the anniversary window. A transfer of limited partnership interests is a reportable event requiring an RBE amendment within one month of the transfer; the annual confirmation is cumulative and does not replace the change notice. The on-site partnership register must reflect every transfer, including date, number of parts, counterparties, and resulting ownership percentages.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Partner Resolutions and Minutes
Partnership agreement (contrat de société) and any amendments

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$2,500–4,500 per year for a Luxembourg corporate services agent (registered office, RCS/RBE filings and statutory register custody)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$6,000–15,000 per year if the statutory audit threshold is exceeded or a transport licence authority requires audited accounts; no mandatory audit fee if exempt under the small/micro undertaking thresholds

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (combined CIT 17% + solidarity surcharge 7% on CIT + municipal business tax 6.75% for Luxembourg City)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: IP box regime (80% exemption on qualifying IP income), investment tax credit (up to 12% for certain assets), participation exemption for dividends and capital gains (100% exemption under conditions), notional interest deduction (NID) for equity financing

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 200 (Corporate Income Tax Return for Partnerships) filed via the Luxembourg eCDF (Electronic Tax Filing) portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing deadline is 31 May of the year following the fiscal year-end; extensions up to 31 December may be granted upon request

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the SCSp (name, RCS number, tax ID)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide Luxembourg tax ID and registered office address; non-resident partners must be identified with their foreign tax IDs

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fiscal year start and end dates
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use calendar year unless a different fiscal year is approved by the tax administration

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total taxable income (before allocation to partners)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report the SCSp's net income computed under Luxembourg GAAP, adjusted for tax rules; non-resident partners are taxed on their share of Luxembourg-source income

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allocation of income to each partner (name, address, tax ID, share percentage)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List all partners, including non-residents; income is allocated according to the partnership agreement and subject to partner-level taxation

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions and tax credits claimed (e.g., investment tax credit, IP box)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners may claim treaty benefits only at their residence level; the SCSp cannot claim credits on their behalf

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of transfer pricing documentation compliance
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that TP documentation is in place if thresholds are met; non-resident partners must ensure their own TP compliance

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of EUR 100 to EUR 1,000 per month, plus 0.6% interest per month on unpaid tax; deliberate non-filing may lead to criminal penalties and director liability

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for SCSp distributions (tax transparent entity); if the SCSp opts to be taxable as a corporation, the domestic rate is 15%
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: For taxable SCSp, treaty relief requires submission of a Luxembourg tax residency certificate (Form 400) and a certificate of residence from the partner's jurisdiction; the reduced rate is applied at source upon prior approval or via refund procedure
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 10% (domestic), treaty rates often 0-5%; Interest: statutory 10% (domestic), treaty rates often 0-10%

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required if the SCSp's related-party transactions exceed EUR 1 million (goods) or EUR 500,000 (services) and the group's consolidated revenue exceeds EUR 50 million; Master File required if group revenue exceeds EUR 50 million and the SCSp is part of a group with cross-border transactions
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg applies Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) for entities engaged in certain activities; for a customs bonded truck fleet, substance is evidenced by physical presence, employees, and operational management in Luxembourg; the SCSp must maintain adequate substance to avoid being classified as a shell company

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate underreporting of income or overstating deductions in the SCSp's tax return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to EUR 250,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years; additional tax of 10% to 50% of the evaded tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for unpaid taxes if they knowingly participated in evasion; civil restitution and travel bans may be imposed

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: SCSp has no physical presence, no employees, and no real business activity in Luxembourg, used solely for tax avoidance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of tax treaty benefits, reclassification of income, and penalties up to EUR 50,000; potential criminal charges for fraud
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for taxes and penalties if they fail to ensure substance; travel bans and asset freezes possible

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to conduct customer due diligence, reporting suspicious transactions, or maintaining records for the bonded truck fleet operations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to EUR 1 million and imprisonment up to 5 years; suspension or revocation of operating license
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally fined and imprisoned; civil liability for damages to third parties

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain TP documentation or applying non-arm's length pricing in cross-border transactions with related parties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Adjustment of taxable income, penalties up to 10% of the adjustment, and interest on underpaid tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally liable for penalties if they knowingly approved non-compliant pricing; potential criminal charges for tax fraud
